shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g '*config*' -g 'index.html' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,155p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat tsconfig.json && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button SegmentedRadioGroup Select Loader Switch && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && sed -n '155,190p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -A 24 '## Yagr' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies dependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies --json'
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button SegmentedRadioGroup Select Loader Switch && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 @gravity-ui/yagr@5.3.1'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh chartkit ChartKit settings && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json'

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh yagr Yagr && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md && rg -n -C 3 'Getting|Usage|style|timeline|series|axes|scales' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/index.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/index.d.ts && rg -n 'interface.*Data|type.*Data|interface.*Props|type.*Props' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/{gravity-charts,yagr}/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/ChartKit.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -110"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-labels.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'interface (ChartData|LineSeries|Axis)|type (ChartData|LineSeries)|dashStyle|tickInterval|tickPixelInterval|labels|grid' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/{chart,series,axis}* -g '*.d.ts' && rg -n 'interface|type|theme|timeUnit|legend|adaptivity' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts | head -85 && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/renderer/GravityChartsWidget.js | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/index.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/value-formatting.md && rg -n 'interface SelectProps|onUpdate|options|value|size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -35 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Loader/Loader.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | rg '/types/.*(axis|line|chart|legend)' && rg -n -C 3 'ChartData|dashStyle|lineWidth|tickInterval|tickPixelInterval' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -115 && rg -n 'theme|timeUnit|legend|adaptivity|axes|scales' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js && sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/hooks/useConfig.js"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts | head -100 && sed -n '41,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'grid|tickInterval|tickPixelInterval|numberFormat|title|dateTime' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -105 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -180 && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/useWidgetData.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/renderer/GravityChartsWidget.js | head -75"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '180,248p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && rg -n -A 65 'interface AxisOptions|interface CommonSeriesOptions|interface ExtendedSeriesOptions' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/legend/legend.d.ts | head -70 && rg -n -A 22 'shapeYagrConfig' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.js && rg -n 'useThemeContext|setTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts && sed -n '175,224p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && sed -n '103,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts | head -100 && cat vite.config.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/libs/settings/settings.d.ts | head -75 && sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/gradient.d.ts | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p src/components src/lib'

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/components/VisualizationWidget.tsx | sed -n '35,43p' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/constants.d.ts | head -50 && rg -n 'divisor|multiplier' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/misc.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/components/VisualizationWidget.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace('setRetry((n) => n + 1);}}/>/>}', 'setRetry((n) => n + 1);}}/>}/> organism')
s=s.replace('/> organism', '/>}')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/widget.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'multiplier|interface FormatNumberOptions|units' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/format.d.ts && sed -n '1,95p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/renderer/utils.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/index.js"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "cat index.html && rg -n -- '--g-color-(base-positive-light|base-generic-ultralight|text-positive)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -5 && rg -n 'theme|timeMultiplier|timeline' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/defaults.js | head -20 && cat .gitignore && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'var\\(--|getComputedStyle|isValidColor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/colors* node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/utils/colors* && git diff --stat && sed -n '1,100p' src/lib/chart-config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build > /tmp/pulse-build.log 2>&1; tail -n 12 /tmp/pulse-build.log'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'timeMultiplier' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore -g '*.js' | head -12 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | rg 'color.*js"'$'"' | head -12 && sed -n '1,120p' src/components/VisualizationWidget.tsx && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color.js && sed -n '105,145p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/mixins/create-options.js && rg -n 'TIME_MULTIPLIER' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/defaults.js && sed -n '1,65p' src/main.tsx && cat package.json"
